case_text: A consumer purchased a newly manufactured television that experienced panel failure within 3 days of installation. The brand service center refused to replace or refund.
gold_precedents: Tata Motors Ltd. vs. Antonio Paulo Vaz

case_text: A direct selling company forced a distributor to buy non-refundable ₹50,000 product inventory without offering a mandatory 30-day cooling-off exit period.
gold_issues: Pyramid inventory forcing and refusal of mandatory cooling-off refund
gold_precedents: Amazon Seller Services Pvt. Ltd. vs. Vishwajit Singh

case_text: A small business owner purchased a commercial fire insurance policy to protect their workshop. When a fire broke out, the insurance company denied the claim stating it was for commercial profit.
gold_issues: Commercial purpose exclusion applicability to insurance indemnity
gold_precedents: National Insurance Co. Ltd. vs. Harsolia Motors

case_text: An online e-commerce platform delivered a defective laptop battery that exploded during charging. The platform disowned responsibility citing third-party seller status.
gold_issues: Marketplace e-commerce platform liability and product seller liability
gold_precedents: Amazon Seller Services Pvt. Ltd. vs. Vishwajit Singh

case_text: A student enrolled in a 2-year coaching institute left after 1 month due to unsatisfactory faculty. The institute cited a signed non-refundable fee agreement.
gold_issues: Unfair contract terms and pro-rata fee refund
